spans.s: (I)--Mt. a hill of the शाकद्वीप; here people are of श्याम colour. Br. II. १९. ८८; M. १२२. १२; वा. ४९. ८२; Vi.
(III)--a son of शूर and भोजा; had no son. Br. III. ७१. १५०, १९४; M. ४६. 3.

(IV)--a son of शमिक; had no issue;

adopted as son the son of वस्तावन; went to the forest; became Bhoja and a राजऋषि.

(V)--a brother of Vasudeva. वा. ९६. १४८ Vi. IV. १४. ३०.
(VI)--one of the two dogs of the family of Vai- vasvata to whom bali is to be offered in यज्ञ. वा. १०८. ३०; १११. ३९.
(I)--a daughter of Meru and wife of हिरण्- maya. भा.
(II)--a name of ललिता; appeared before the sage मातन्ग and agreed to be his daughter. Hence मातन्गी. Br. IV. १७. ८३; २८. ३७; ३१. ८४, ९३. [page३-472+ २४]
(IV)--a R. of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १७.
--a son of देवमीढ and मारिषा; married शूरभू and had two sons, हरिकेश and हिरण्याक्ष. भा. IX. २४. २९ and ४२.
(I)--the chief author of Yajurveda, of the northern recension. Br. II. ३५. १२.
--ridiculed Garga as impotent in an assembly of the यादवस्. Vi. V. २३. 1. [page३-473+ २५]
--of आत्रेय gotra and a sage. Br. II. ३२. ११३; M. १९७. 5.

--a jewel presented by the Sun god to सत्रा- jita (s.v.) to enable him to see his form distinctly without be- ing blinded by his hallow; had the quality of yielding eight loads of gold every day. कृष्ण thought that Ugrasena was worthy of having it; knowing this सत्राजित् gave it to his brother Prasena. He placed it in a room and hedged it with divinity. कृष्ण asked for it and was refused. It was taken to the forest by Prasena whom a lion killed. जाम्बवा killed the lion and got the jewel. कृष्ण fought with him and recover- ing the jewel, returned it to सत्राजित in a public assembly. सत्राजित offered his daughter in marriage to कृष्ण and made a gift of the jewel. कृष्ण returned it to सत्राजित. शतधन्वन् killed सत्राजित and took it, and placed it with अक्रूर for safe custody. This led to some misunderstand- ing between कृष्ण and राम, and at कृष्ण's request, अक्रूर made it public that it was in his possession. भा. X. ३७. १८; cch. ५६ and ५७ (whole); Br. III. ७१. २६, ५२, ८२, ९८. M. ४

--a place of pilgrimage near Kuruk- षेत्र where the rival armies met in battle. A क्षेत्र sacred to परशुराम: Nine pools of blood were made here by परशुराम after killing all the क्षत्रियस् of the earth twenty-one times. Here came कृष्ण and the Yadus to observe solar eclipse. After fasting and bathing, Brahmans and other guests were fed. Thither came Nanda and the Gopas as well as भीष्म, द्रोण and other sages and kings. [page३-723+ २५] All of them exchanged greetings. द्रौपदी spent her time with कृष्ण's wives asking them about their marriages. Here कृष्ण and Vasudeva performed a sacrifice. A तीर्थ on the banks of the सरस्वती where दिती engaged herself in penance. भा. IX. १६. १९; X. ७८ [९५ (V) १९]; chh. ८२, ८३ and ८४ (whole).
